ranking_method.score: value / sqrt(cost), multiplied by (1 + unblock_bonus) when the item unblocks at least one item
tie_breakers: primary source type, where the primary source is sources[0]: gh_issue, then impl_stub, then research_folder
primary source ref: issue number ascending for gh_issue, otherwise the ref path in code-point order
primary source item text in code-point order (absent item sorts first)

impact_definitions.silent_wrong_output: A shipped tool path completes without error or warning and publishes a value or feature that is wrong under an established rule.
impact_definitions.data_correctness: Output or reference data can be wrong or ungoverned, but the correct value still needs a rule or decision to define it, a guard or validation is missing, or the wrong value already surfaces with a warning or error.
impact_definitions.runtime_failure: A tool or library path raises or aborts on an input it accepts.
impact_definitions.dev_velocity: Tests, CI or developer tooling are slower, noisier or less trustworthy than they need to be; no tool output changes.
impact_definitions.maintainability: Structure, duplication, dead code, missing tests or latent defects that no current production path reaches; no tool output changes.
impact_definitions.docs_tooling: Documentation, research records, configuration or agent tooling outside the shipped tool paths.

severity_scale.1: Cosmetic or hygiene: renames, dead code, stale docs, a test gap for working or accepted behavior, or hardening of a check that tests already cover.
severity_scale.2: Debt with a concrete cost, a latent defect that no current path reaches, a missing guard, or a defect that needs a rare or optional input.
severity_scale.3: A wrong or failing result on a supported but uncommon input, or a defect a warning already surfaces.
severity_scale.4: Wrong published output on a common input of a production tool path, or a failure that blocks a supported workflow.
severity_scale.5: Crashes or corrupts a production tool path on its normal inputs.

ranking_method.notes: GitHub-issue items carry severity, impact, LoE and blast radius from the verified issue triage. _IMPL_TODO stub items and research-folder items carry LoE and blast radius from their source; their impact and severity are assigned in this catalog. Merged items take the largest LoE and blast radius among their sources unless the item states a combined LoE. Ranking compares scores rounded to 4 decimals; the tie breakers apply in order and separate every item, so ids and ranks are reproducible from the item fields alone.
